paper_title: scGPT: toward building a foundation model for single-cell multi-omics using generative AI

split.note: Same split as GEARS for fair comparison; hold out unseen 2-gene combinations

preprocess.note: scGPT uses gene vocab limited to ~1200 perturbed-relevant genes; full vocab varies by pretrain checkpoint

metrics.name: pearson_de
metrics.note: Pearson on top-20 DEGs, consistent with GEARS benchmark

reported_values._note: Approximate — verify against Table in scGPT Nature Methods 2024 perturbation section. Varies by checkpoint used (whole-human vs task-specific).

notes: Critical detail: scGPT perturbation task uses a fine-tuned checkpoint, not the base pretrained model. Using the wrong checkpoint is a common Protocol Fidelity failure. The n_hvg varies significantly between checkpoints.
